name: Finglas, Dublin

dataSources.name: Tailte Éireann High Value Dataset - Ways (road surface polygons)

constantsNote: Place centre is the middle of the Finglas box in research/world-drive/28-lane-widths.md (-6.323,53.38,-6.269,53.412). Gravity: WGS84 normal gravity (Somigliana formula) at 53.396 N, sea level. Air density: ideal gas law, p = 101325 Pa (ISO 2533 standard sea-level pressure), T = 9.7 °C (Met Éireann Dublin Airport 1991–2020 annual mean; see constantsSources for what was and was not checked).

constantsSources.source: WGS84 normal gravity (Somigliana formula, k = 1.931852652458e-3, e² = 6.69437999014e-3, equatorial gravity 9.7803253359 m/s²), standard NIMA TR8350.2 (2000). Constants read from the published tables at ahrs.readthedocs.io; the TR8350.2 text itself was not opened. Recomputing the formula at the place's latitude gives the stored value (tested).
constantsSources.period: Not a climate value: defining constants of the WGS84 ellipsoid (2000 edition of TR8350.2)

constantsSources.source: Temperature: Met Éireann Dublin Airport 1991–2020 averages, annual mean temperature 9.7 °C (the nearest long-record station to Finglas; the figure was read from the table's text as shown in a web search result, and the page was not opened in full). Pressure: ISO 2533 standard sea-level pressure 101325 Pa, which is NOT a Met Éireann normal; no 1991–2020 pressure normal was found. Dry air, R = 287.05 J/(kg·K), humidity ignored.
